comment: Display-only pose of the Support3D.glb origin in tool0 (ROS axes, meters/radians). GLB body axes: +X is the long axis with the flange-mounting plate at GLB +X=+0.1595 (plate normal +X, plate centered at GLB y=+0.0079); the broad holder faces are perpendicular to GLB Y, with the phone screen opening toward GLB -Y. rpy=[0,+pi/2,0] maps GLB +X -> tool0 -Z, so the plate seats on the flange plane (tool0 z=0, centered on the tool0 axis) and the support EXITS along tool0 +Z, which on a UR points outward from the flange. The screen then faces tool0 -Y and the mire Z (into the screen) points tool0 +Y. The in-plane clocking around tool0 Z and the metrology-grade T_tool0_mire are co-solved by hand-eye calibration; this mount is only a visual aid.
